## Twilio reconciliation (stub)
NOT BUILT YET -- placeholder only, per the master plan's Stage 0 item 7 ("stubbed but not fully built"). No Twilio credential exists anywhere in this project (nothing in local-agent/watcher ever called Twilio's API directly) and this is the one workflow in the whole migration that cannot make ANY real progress without one -- unlike pipeline-failed-media-retry, there is no local-only half to build first.

Design already confirmed with the user (see the plan, "Decisions confirmed with the user for this pass"): list Twilio's Messages API for the last N hours, cross-check against inbound_messages.twilio_message_sid, and for anything Twilio has that the DB doesn't -- BOTH auto-replay the message through the same kind-detection/Storage-upload/contacts-from-ocr-or-note_submissions logic twilio-webhook uses, AND alert a human that this happened. Never a silent auto-fix: a gap gets closed automatically but stays visible.

Should share its actual replay logic with pipeline-failed-media-retry's (also-deferred) redownload step once both are built for real -- both are fundamentally "re-run twilio-webhook's per-media processing outside the original request," worth factoring into one shared sub-workflow.

Twilio credential needed: prefer a scoped Twilio API Key restricted to read-only Messages/Media access over the all-powerful main Auth Token, consistent with the least-privilege posture applied everywhere else in this migration.

Also a manual TODO for the user, outside any tool available here: configure Twilio's Fallback URL (Console setting, phone-number/Messaging-Service level) before watcher/ is fully retired in practice -- MMS becomes the sole intake path and there is currently no fallback if the Edge Function is down/cold-starting/mid-deploy when a text arrives.

INACTIVE / BUILD-ONLY (n8n migration Stage 0).
